svg.text: As built: one FastAPI service (modular routers) + MongoDB + React. Not a microservice mesh.
React 18 · Tailwind · Recharts · Web Speech API (STT/TTS) · browser WebRTC · role-based navigation (patient, doctor, hospital, lab, pharmacy, blood bank, ambulance, family, admin)
Public pages (no login): /kiosk health kiosk · /card public emergency card
9 risk models · symptom checker multi-disease score · digital twin
OpenCV analysis · optional ONNX X-ray · MRI · skin · retina
OpenCV + Tesseract + parser verify BEFORE reminders
alert engine · fall detection wearable ingest
users · patients · vitals · reports appointments · medicines · audit
per-patient SHA-256 chain fingerprints only, no medical data
trained risk models optional ONNX image models
Security: JWT + RBAC on every route · consent-gated access · every third-party read logged to the ledger · DEV_MODE must be 0 in production
